subject: general
question: Where is 'Paithan Hydroelectric Project' located in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Paithan Hydroelectric Project **is located in **Maharastra**.
 
• It was **made **at the **Godavari river**.
 
• It is **completed **with the **help of Japan**.
 
• The **dam's created **reservoir is known **as Nath Sagar Jalashay**.
 
• **Mrs. Indira Gandhi, **the prime minister at the time, gave it its **inauguration in 1976.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
